raw_segments.text: Aego, how poor are they that have not patience?
What wound did ever heal but by degrees?
Thou know'st ye we work by wit and not by witchcraft, and wit depends on dilatory time.
Cassio hath beaten thee, and thou by that small hurt hast cashierd Cassio, though other
things grow fair against the sun, yet fruits that blossom first will first be ripe.
By the mass, tease mourning, pleasure and action make the hours seem short.
Retire thee, go where thou art billeted.
Away I say thou shalt no more hereafter.
